title: PromptShot: Capture. Paste. Build with AI. | Product Hunt
excerpt: PromptShot — Screenshot to AI prompt Chrome extension for Cursor, ChatGPT & Claude PromptShot is a vibe coding and AI coding Chrome extension that lets you drag to capture any region of a web page, then copy an LLM-ready prompt and PNG image to your clipboard in one step—ready to paste into Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini. Skip long setup messages. For UI fixes, bug reports, design handoff, and component extraction, go capture → paste (Ctrl+V) → ship the next prompt.
